He previously played for the [[NBA G League Ignite]], and appeared in one [[NBA]] game for the [[Philadelphia 76ers]]. ==High school career== Foster attended [[Washington High School of Information Technology (Milwaukee, Wisconsin)|Washington High School of Information Technology]] in [[Milwaukee]], [[Wisconsin]].{{cite web |last=Stewart |first=Mark |title=Freshman Michael Foster playing like a veteran for Milwaukee Washington |url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/high-schools/2018/01/10/freshman-michael-foster-playing-like-veteran-milwaukee-washington/1020474001/ |website=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]] |access-date=April 11, 2021 |date=December 18, 2017}} He led his team to a state runner-up finish in each of his first two years.{{cite web |last=Obert |first=Richard |title=Hillcrest Prep could be grooming another No.1 NBA draft pick in Michael Foster |url=https://www.azcentral.com/story/sports/high-school/2019/05/20/michael-foster-joins-hillcrest-prep-national-basketball-team/3740539002/ |website=[[The Arizona Republic]] |access-date=April 11, 2021 |date=May 20, 2019}} For his junior season, Foster transferred to Hillcrest Prep in [[Phoenix, Arizona]].{{cite web |last=Obert |first=Richard |title=Hillcrest Prep's Michael Foster aspires to be better than Deandre Ayton |url=https://www.azcentral.com/story/sports/high-school/2021/01/21/hillcrest-preps-michael-foster-aspires-better-than-7-footayton/4235442001/ |website=[[The Arizona Republic]] |access-date=April 11, 2021 |date=January 21, 2021}} As a senior, he averaged 32.2 points and 18.4 rebounds per game.{{cite web |title=Five-star Prospect Michael Foster Jr. Signs With NBA G League Ignite |url=https://gleague.nba.com/news/five-star-prospect-michael-foster-jr-signs-with-nba-g-league-ignite/ |publisher=[[NBA G League]] |access-date=April 23, 2021 |date=April 23, 2021}} Foster was named to the [[2021 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|McDonald's All-American Game]] and [[Jordan Brand Classic]] rosters.{{cite web |last=Obert |first=Richard |title=Hillcrest's Michael Foster is only Arizona player named to McDonald's All-American basketball team |url=https://www.azcentral.com/story/sports/high-school/2021/02/23/hillcrests-michael-foster-lone-az-player-named-mcdonalds-team/4564115001/ |website=[[The Arizona Republic]] |access-date=April 11, 2021 |date=February 23, 2021}} ===Recruiting=== Foster was rated a five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] by [[ESPN]] and [[247Sports]], and a four-star recruit by [[Rivals.com|Rivals]]. As a freshman in high school, Foster committed to playing college basketball for [[Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball|Arizona State]],{{cite web |last=Stewart |first=Mark |title=Recruiting: Milwaukee Washington freshman Michael Foster commits to Arizona State |url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/high-schools/2017/12/18/recruiting-milwaukee-washington-freshman-michael-foster-commits-arizona-state/963759001/ |website=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]] |access-date=April 11, 2021 |date=December 18, 2017}} but reopened his recruitment in the following year.{{cite web |last=Evans |first=Corey |title=Elite 2021 forward Michael Foster decommits from Arizona State |url=https://basketballrecruiting.rivals.com/news/elite-2021-forward-michael-foster-decommits-from-arizona-state |website=[[Rivals.com|Rivals]] |access-date=April 11, 2021 |date=June 26, 2018}} On April 23, 2021, he announced that he would join the [[NBA G League]], forgoing college basketball. He chose the G League over offers from [[Florida State Seminoles men's basketball|Florida State]] and [[Georgia Bulldogs basketball|Georgia]].{{cite web |last=Spears |first=Marc J. |title=Top prep forward Michael Foster chooses G League Ignite over Florida State, Georgia |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/31317295 |website=[[ESPN]] |access-date=April 23, 2021 |date=April 23, 2021}} overall = 9 | accessdate = September 17, 2021 | bball = yes }} ==Professional career== ===NBA G League Ignite (2021–2022)=== On April 23, 2021, Foster signed with the [[NBA G League Ignite]], a developmental team affiliated with the [[NBA G League]]. ===Philadelphia 76ers (2022)=== After going undrafted in the [[2022 NBA draft]], Foster signed an [[Exhibit 10]] contract with the [[Philadelphia 76ers]].{{Cite web |date=July 10, 2022 |title=Michael Foster Jr. Signed By Philadelphia 76ers |url=https://www.nba.com/sixers/news/76ers-sign-michael-foster-jr |access-date=July 14, 2022 |website=nba.com}}{{Cite web |last=Levick |first=Noah |date=July 11, 2022 |title=Sixers sign undrafted rookie Michael Foster Jr. to Exhibit 10 deal |url=https://www.nbcsports.com/philadelphia/sixers/sixer-sign-michael-foster-jr-exhibit-10-contract-sixers-roster-nba |access-date=July 14, 2022 |website=RSN |language=en}} Foster joined the 76ers' roster in the [[2022 NBA Summer League]].{{Cite web |title=Philadelphia 76ers 2022 NBA2K23 Summer League Roster {{!}} NBA.com |url=https://www.nba.com/summer-league/2022/vegas/team/1610612755/sixers |access-date=July 14, 2022 |website=nba.com}} In his Summer League debut, Foster scored five points in a Salt Lake City Summer League game against the [[Memphis Grizzlies]].{{Cite web |date=July 5, 2022 |title=Memphis Grizzlies vs Philadelphia 76ers Jul 5, 2022 Box Scores {{!}} NBA.com |url=https://www.nba.com/game/mem-vs-phi-1622200001/box-score#box-score |access-date=July 14, 2022 |website=NBA.com}} On October 16, 2022, Foster's contract was converted to a [[two-way contract|two-way]].{{cite web|last=Hill|first=Arthur|title=Sixers Convert Michael Foster Jr. To Two-Way Deal, Waive Charlie Brown Jr.|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2022/10/sixers-to-give-michael-foster-jr-two-way-contract-waive-charlie-brown-jr.html|website=Hoops Rumors|date=October 16, 2022|access-date=October 16, 2022}} He was released into free agency on November 23 following the signing of [[Saben Lee]].{{Cite web |last=Harris |first=Declan |date=November 22, 2022 |title=76ers Replace Michael Foster Jr. With Saben Lee |url=https://www.si.com/nba/76ers/news/76ers-sign-saben-lee-waive-michael-foster-jr |access-date=November 23, 2022 |website=si.com}} ===Delaware Blue Coats (2022–2023)=== On December 5, Foster re-joined the [[Delaware Blue Coats]]{{cite web|title=2022-2023 Delaware Blue Coats Transactions History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/dleague/teams/Delaware-Blue-Coats/57/Transaction_History/2023|website=RealGM.com|access-date=December 7, 2022}} and eventually helped the team win the NBA G League title.{{cite web|first=Noah|last=Levick|title=Delaware Blue Coats win G League championship; Jaden Springer named Finals MVP|url=https://www.nbcsports.com/philadelphia/sixers/delaware-blue-coats-nba-g-league-championship-2023-jaden-springer-mac-mcclung|website=NBCSports.com|date=April 7, 2023|access-date=April 7, 2023}} ===Capital City Go-Go (2023–2024)=== On October 11, 2023, Foster signed with the [[Washington Wizards]],{{cite tweet|author=Washington Wizards|title=Official: We have signed Michael Foster Jr. to an Exhibit 10 contract. We have also waived Chase Audige.|number=1712143558038151475|user=WashWizards|date=October 11, 2023|access-date=October 11, 2023}} but was waived on October 20.{{cite tweet|author=Washington Wizards|title=Official: We have waived Devon Dotson and Michael Foster Jr.|number=1715593260997984687|user=WashWizards|date=October 20, 2023|access-date=October 21, 2023}} Ten days later, he joined the [[Capital City Go-Go]].{{cite web|title=Go-Go Announce Training Camp Roster, Dates|url=https://capitalcity.gleague.nba.com/news/go-go-announce-training-camp-roster-dates|website=NBA.com|date=October 30, 2023|access-date=November 26, 2023}} ===Cangrejeros de Santurce (2024)=== On April 13, 2024, Foster signed with the [[Cangrejeros de Santurce (basketball)|Cangrejeros de Santurce]] of the [[Baloncesto Superior Nacional]].{{cite tweet|author=La Guerra del BSN|title=#BSNPR {{¡}} OFICIAL: El delantero Michael Foster Jr. es el nuevo refuerzo de los Cangrejeros de Santurce en sustitución de Ed Davis quien sale por lesión. Foster Jr. tiene 22 años, mide 6’9, tiene experiencia NBA con los Philadelphia 76ers y viene de promediar 9.5 PPJ, 6.6 RPJ y 1 BPJ en 22 MPJ con el club Capital C-Go en la G-League.|number=1779167804526100819|user=LaGuerraBSN|date=April 13, 2024|access-date=April 13, 2024|language=Spanish}} ===Jiangxi Ganchi (2024)=== On June 12, 2024, Foster signed with Jiangxi Ganchi of the [[National Basketball League (China)|National Basketball League]].{{cite tweet|author=RUDY_Z|title=Baylee Steele and Michael Foster Jr. signed with Jiangxi team of Chinese NBL league.|number=1800795846344397258|user=RUDY_Z_|date=June 12, 2024|access-date=November 3, 2024}} ===Return to Capital City (2024–present)=== On October 28, 2024, Foster rejoined the [[Capital City Go-Go]].{{cite web|title=Go-Go Announce Training Camp Roster, Dates|url=https://capitalcity.gleague.nba.com/news/go-go-announce-training-camp-roster-dates-2|website=NBA.com|date=October 28,
